    Auth¶

    rn_forge.web.auth ¶

    Framework-independent authentication and authorization contracts.

    Missing or invalid credentials produce a 401 challenge; an authenticated principal without sufficient access produces 403. Verification details must not be exposed in the 401 response.

    AUTH_FAILED_DETAIL = 'Authentication failed.' module-attribute ¶

    The non-sensitive detail returned for authentication failures.

    BearerErrorCode = Literal['invalid_request', 'invalid_token', 'insufficient_scope'] ¶

    The error codes RFC 6750 §3 defines for a Bearer challenge.

    AsyncAuthenticator ¶

    Bases: Protocol

    Asynchronous counterpart of :class:Authenticator.

    authenticate(*, credentials) async ¶

    See :meth:Authenticator.authenticate.

    Authenticator ¶

    Bases: Protocol

    Turns raw credentials into a verified :class:Principal.

    authenticate(*, credentials) ¶

    Verify credentials.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    AuthenticationFailed

    The credentials are absent, malformed or invalid. The message must not say which.

    Authorizer ¶

    Bases: Protocol

    Decides whether a verified principal may proceed.

    authorize(principal, *, requires) ¶

    Permit the request, or refuse it.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    PermissionDenied

    The principal lacks the required access. Never :class:~rn_forge.web.exceptions.AuthenticationFailed — the caller is authenticated; that is the 401/403 boundary.

    Credentials(scheme, token, extras=dict[str, Any]()) dataclass ¶

    Raw credentials lifted off the request, before verification.

    scheme is the HTTP auth scheme as sent (Bearer, Basic, ...) and token its parameter, verbatim. This is what a framework binding hands an :class:Authenticator; nothing here interprets it.

    Principal(subject, issuer=None, scopes=frozenset(), roles=frozenset(), tenant=None, claims=dict[str, Any](), mechanism='bearer') dataclass ¶

    Bases: DataclassMixin

    The verified caller.

    subject is the only required field. claims retains verified values not represented by the common fields.

    from_dict(data) classmethod ¶

    Create an instance from a dict, recursively rebuilding nested dataclasses.

    Only keys that match declared dataclass field names are passed to the constructor. This makes from_dict tolerant of extra data (e.g. when loading from a config file that has fields added in a newer schema version). Nested dataclass-typed fields are reconstructed recursively for common container annotations, via :mod:dacite.

    Note a nested dataclass field's own overridden from_dict (if any) is not called — dacite structures nested dataclasses itself.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    data dict[str, Any]

    A dict whose keys correspond to dataclass field names. Unrecognised keys are silently ignored, or rejected when the class's __dacite_config__ sets strict.

    		 required

    Returns:

    Type Description
    Self

    A new instance of this class populated with matching field values.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    AppException

    A value does not match its field's declared type, a required field is absent, or an enum-typed field names a member the enum does not define. Under strict, also a key that names no field, at any nesting level; the message lists every such key by its dotted path (repository.archtype).
    TypeError

    If the subclass was not decorated with @dataclasses.dataclass.

    Requirement(any_scope=frozenset(), all_scopes=frozenset(), any_role=frozenset(), all_roles=frozenset()) dataclass ¶

    A declarative access requirement, evaluated identically by both frameworks.

    All four sets are ANDed together; within any_* the members are ORed. An empty requirement is satisfied by any principal — it means "authenticated", not "denied".

    is_satisfied_by(principal) ¶

    Return whether principal meets every clause of this requirement.

    challenge_header(*, scheme='Bearer', realm=None, error=None, error_description=None, scope=None) ¶

    Build a WWW-Authenticate challenge.

    Parameters follow RFC 6750 for Bearer and RFC 7617 for Basic. None values are omitted.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    scheme str

    Bearer or Basic.

    		 'Bearer'
    realm str | None

    The protection space.

    		 None
    error BearerErrorCode | None

    One of RFC 6750's three codes. Bearer only.

    		 None
    error_description str | None

    Non-sensitive human-readable text.

    		 None
    scope str | None

    The scope required, for insufficient_scope.

    		 None

    Returns:

    Type Description
    str

    A complete challenge header value.

    Example::

    challenge_header(realm="example")
# 'Bearer realm="example"'
challenge_header(realm="example", error="insufficient_scope", scope="read")
# 'Bearer realm="example", error="insufficient_scope", scope="read"'

    parse_authorization(header, scheme) ¶

    Return the scheme credentials in an Authorization header value.

    The scheme is matched case-insensitively (RFC 9110 §11.1) and the token is returned verbatim apart from surrounding whitespace — it may be empty.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    header str | None

    The Authorization header value, or None when absent.

    		 required
    scheme str

    The expected scheme, e.g. "Bearer".

    		 required

    Returns:

    Type Description
    Credentials | None

    Credentials(scheme, token), or None when header is absent or
    Credentials | None

    names another scheme.

    principal_from_claims(claims, *, mechanism='bearer') ¶

    The default mapping from verified token claims to a :class:Principal.

    Claims are read as the common IdPs issue them:

    Principal Claim
    subject sub (required)
    issuer iss
    scopes scope (RFC 8693 §4.2, space-delimited) or scp (string or list)
    roles roles (a list)
    tenant tid

    Any other shape — a nested realm_access.roles, a custom group claim — is deployment-specific: override the mapping and read :attr:Principal.claims, which retains every verified claim.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    claims Mapping[str, Any]

    Claims already verified by the caller.

    		 required
    mechanism str

    Recorded on the principal.

    		 'bearer'

    Raises:

    Type Description
    AuthenticationFailed

    There is no sub. The detail stays generic.
